content_of_post_to_answer: How can changing your mindset improve your chances of success?
answer: Changing your mindset works less by creating confidence and more by changing the questions you ask when facing difficulty. A fixed mindset asks "Why am I failing?" while a growth mindset asks "What is this failure revealing?" I explore this pattern in more detail on my profile for anyone curious. The biggest shift is realizing success is often built by improving your response to setbacks, not avoiding them.
